decisions.decision: Do not contact the client; only Amal sends. Build everything around the ask now. 1) From [redacted].md, write a ready-to-send email for Amal in [redacted].md (private, client not named on the public board). It names the test (two cold-email variants, A and B), the exact list, the sender mailboxes, the 7-day start and end dates, the stop rules, and ends with one line asking the client to reply 'Yes, approved'. Leave any value the spec does not hold as a clearly marked blank for Amal. 2) Create workshop-plan/coord/T-363-client-reply.md as the place to paste the reply. 3) Put both paths in a T-363 note for Amal. 4) Meanwhile do T-155 'Before live' step 2 (read-only audit of the client account) and draft variant copy A and B for client review. When the reply is saved, tick spec step 1 and mark T-363 done.
